name: Ruhunu Maha Kataragama Devalaya (Sacred City)
description: Discover the sacred heart of Kataragama at Ruhunu Maha Kataragama Devalaya, a multi-faith pilgrimage site where devotees seek blessings under ancient trees and vibrant altars. This holy city is a testament to the rich cultural tapestry of Sri Lanka, blending Buddhist, Hindu, and Islamic traditions in its serene temples and bustling streets.
activities: Prayer and Meditation, Artisan Market Exploration, Historical Site Visits

name: Kiri Vehera, Kataragama
description: Kiri Vehera, a stunning Buddhist stupa in Kataragama, stands majestically atop a hill, its intricate carvings and serene atmosphere attracting pilgrims and nature lovers alike. Perched on a hilltop, this ancient monument offers breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape and is a must-visit for those seeking spiritual enlightenment and natural beauty.
activities: Prayer and Meditation, Photography, Nature Walk

name: Kataragama Maha Devale (inner shrine)
description: Discover the inner sanctum of Kataragama Maha Devale, a sacred Hindu-Buddhist temple where devotees seek blessings and immortality. Admire intricate carvings and the serene atmosphere that draws pilgrims from around the world.

name: Maligawila Giant Buddha Statue
description: Maligawila Giant Buddha Statue stands majestically in the heart of the Monaragala district, a serene site that has stood as a testament to Buddhist artistry since the 14th century. This colossal statue, carved into a cliff face, offers visitors a glimpse into the rich cultural heritage of Sri Lanka.
monsoon_note: Generally drier than western wet zone

name: Kataragama Kiri Vehera Second Devale
description: Discover the spiritual heart of Kataragama at Kataragama Kiri Vehera Second Devale, a sacred Hindu-Buddhist temple nestled amidst lush paddy fields. Witness ancient statues and intricate carvings that tell tales of devotion and faith.
activities: Prayer offerings, Reflection on faith, Photography

name: Nilgala Forest Monastery
description: Discover the serene Nilgala Forest Monastery nestled amidst ancient trees and lush vegetation. This sacred site offers a tranquil retreat where one can immerse themselves in Buddhist teachings and nature’s beauty.
activities: Prayer and Meditation, Nature Walk, Reflection
rain_sensitivity: Generally dry, but avoid May to Sept

name: Kataragama Second Devalaya (Pathini)
description: Discover the sacred Pathini Temple, a mystical site where devotees seek blessings. Nestled in the heart of Kataragama, this ancient devalaya is a testament to Buddhist devotion and tradition, attracting pilgrims from around the world.
activities: Prayer and Meditation, Artisanal Shopping, Cultural Tours

name: Kataragama Vishnu Devale
description: Discover the sacred Vishnu Temple at Kataragama, a place where devotees seek blessings and enlightenment. This ancient devale stands as a testament to the deep Hindu-Buddhist traditions of Sri Lanka, offering visitors a glimpse into the heart of Sri Lankan spirituality.
activities: Prayer and Meditation, Artisanal Shopping, Cultural Show
